## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add textarea
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Textarea.gx` | `ui/textarea/Textarea.gx` |
| `Textarea.fixtures.go` | `ui/textarea/Textarea.fixtures.go` |
| `styles.go` | `ui/textarea/styles.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/textarea/Textarea.gx"
package textarea

props {
  Name        string   = ""
  Value       string   = ""
  Placeholder string   = ""
  Rows        int      = 4
  Class       string   = ""
  Attrs       gx.Attrs = nil
}

<textarea name={p.Name} rows={p.rows()} placeholder={p.Placeholder} class={gx.Cx("flex min-h-16 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-base shadow-xs outline-none transition-[color,box-shadow] placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 md:text-sm", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Value}</textarea>
```

```go title="ui/textarea/Textarea.fixtures.go"
package textarea

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var TextareaFixtures = gx.Fixtures[TextareaProps]{
	"Placeholder": {Placeholder: "Tell us more."},
	"Filled":      {Value: "A short note.", Attrs: gx.Attrs{{Key: "aria-label", Value: "Note"}}},
	"Disabled":    {Attrs: gx.Attrs{gx.Bool("disabled", true)}, Placeholder: "Disabled"},
}
```

```go title="ui/textarea/styles.go"
package textarea

// rows returns the visible rows; a zero value is 4.
func (p TextareaProps) rows() int {
	if p.Rows == 0 {
		return 4
	}
	return p.Rows
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--input`, `--ring`, `--muted-foreground`.

## Usage

```gx
<textarea.Textarea name="note" rows={6} placeholder="Tell us more." />
```

## Examples

### Placeholder

<Example item="textarea" name="textarea-placeholder" label="Textarea: Placeholder">

```gx
<textarea.Textarea placeholder="Tell us more." />
```

</Example>

### Filled

<Example item="textarea" name="textarea-filled" label="Textarea: Filled">

```gx
<textarea.Textarea value="A short note." attrs={gx.Attrs{{Key: "aria-label", Value: "Note"}}} />
```

</Example>

### Disabled

<Example item="textarea" name="textarea-disabled" label="Textarea: Disabled">

```gx
<textarea.Textarea attrs={gx.Attrs{gx.Bool("disabled", true)}} placeholder="Disabled" />
```

</Example>

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Use a textarea for a message longer than one line.
- Set `Rows` to the expected size.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use a textarea for a single value.
- Do not disable the resize handle unless the layout needs it.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the textarea. |
| Enter | Inserts a new line. |
